summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature without running any code and without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _Reader and _ReaderContext classes, private _file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file after track(), Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods before start_task); tests/test_progress.py (16 new tests before the script-entry block); docs/source/progress.rst (two tilde-underlined subsections before Multiple Progress); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 1759). Unverified: tests, mypy, black, and docs build were not run. I omitted the spec's suppression on the module-level open return because strict mypy flags unused ignores and I could not confirm the error; add it if mypy reports one. The module-level open uses io.open internally because its name shadows the builtin.
